## Problem and change

Describe the concrete problem and the resulting behavior. Link an issue if there is one.

## Validation

List commands run and results, plus any skipped or failed checks and why. `npm run build`
already includes the source gates. For documentation/forms, check links and formatting.

For desktop behavior, record the version/build, OS/hardware, and manually observed result.
For UI changes, attach a screenshot or recording with synthetic content.

## Compatibility and data

Describe effects on offline operation, IPC/file access, Library data, `.clipthat` projects,
supported platforms, or bundled dependencies, if relevant. Follow the UI contract for UI edits.
See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/XtraSaltyDev/clip-that/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
and [RELEASE.md](https://github.com/XtraSaltyDev/clip-that/blob/main/RELEASE.md).

Keep the PR in draft while implementation or required desktop validation is unfinished.
Send vulnerability details through [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/XtraSaltyDev/clip-that/security/policy)
rather than this public PR.
